name: Digital Downloads
description: Sell or give away downloadable products. Each product file is a PRIVATE media-library item (stored outside the public uploads folder); buyers get an expiring, limited-use download link by email or on screen, and every download is checked and streamed by the host, so no permanent file URL is ever revealed. Free products deliver instantly with an email; paid orders stay pending until the admin marks them paid (the link is then auto-emailed).
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read products and orders (download tokens, usage counters) from the plugin's own tables.
Create the plugin's tables and write products, orders, sales/download counters and token usage.
Read the plugin's configuration option (currency symbol, manual-payment instructions, link expiry) and the site URL for building download links.
Public routes for the product grid, order creation and token-gated download; admin routes for products/orders/config management.
Add the 'Descargas Digitales' entry to the admin sidebar.

Deliver each product's PRIVATE media file: confirm the selected file is private and have the host stream it as the response of the token-gated download route, after the paid/expiry/max-uses checks pass. Without it no product file can be delivered.
Email buyers their download link (or order-received notice) and notify the admin about new pending orders.
